one_line: On an external runway dataset/model independent of VerifyGAN/TinyTaxiNet, a broad pixel L_inf ball admits class-confusion witnesses that local-PCA and label-conditioned neighbor-box regions remove, while a same-extent brightness invariant removes none; the audit scores the broad-ball witnesses far from held-out runway-image support.

dataset.name: LARD V2
dataset.license: MIT (LARD code/labels); GES imagery under Google Earth terms, academic use

target_selection_note: Strongest learnable balanced-tercile target (ties broken toward runway-relative approach geometry). At a Marabou-tractable grayscale input, only coarse vertical framing / horizon position (camera pitch attitude) is reliably learnable (~0.85); fine runway-relative geometry targets (lateral/CTE-analog, distance, glideslope) sit near the 0.33 chance level and are not reliably learnable here. We therefore verify a pitch-attitude classifier and report the geometry-target limitation explicitly.
property: targeted class-confusion Y_target >= Y_true (runner-up target); SAT = witness exists

headline.R1_robust_at_smaller_eps: R1 is UNSAT at eps in {0.1,0.2,0.3} on 50/50, 50/50, and 50/50 anchors, respectively; at eps=0.4 it is SAT on 32/50.

controls.R2_same_extent_brightness_band: R2@0.4 (= R1@0.4 + class mean-brightness band) stays SAT 32/32: a same-pixel-extent linear invariant leaves the broad witnesses in place.
controls.R4_unbounded_vs_bounded: R4 unbounded at 3 sigma is UNSAT 48/50 (SAT 2, timeout 0); R4 valid-pixel bounded at 3 sigma is UNSAT 50/50 (SAT 0, timeout 0). The valid-pixel constraints remove out-of-cube reconstructions.

witness_audit.reading: R1 broad-ball witnesses are in-cube with weak held-out-image support: per-pair Lipschitz violation ~19x the real baseline and nearest-real L2 ~4x the real same-class neighbor distance.

honest_caveats: The verified quantity is a coarse camera-pitch attitude band (a horizon/vertical-framing proxy). Lateral/CTE-analog, distance, and glideslope targets were near chance (~0.40) at the Marabou-tractable grayscale resolution, so the LARD verification target is pitch attitude.

R1 only admits witnesses at a large radius (eps=0.4); the network is robust to moderate pixel balls (eps<=0.3) on these confident anchors. The large-ball SAT witnesses have weak held-out support and are removed by the data-conditioned regions.
This is an external transfer check on one model, 50 anchors, and a coarse pitch-attitude target. The interpretation is limited to that setting.
independence: Uses LARD V2 (DEEL-AI, Google Earth Studio imagery), a different dataset, generator, and authorship from VerifyGAN/TinyTaxiNet (X-Plane). No VerifyGAN data is used.
